player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in SimpleTak.
On the board, your stones appear as '{player_stone}' and your opponent's stones appear as '{opponent_stone}'.

On your turn, choose one empty cell (by its numbered index) and place your stone there.
For example, '[12]' places your stone in cell 12.

Your objective is to form a continuous path of your stones that connects two opposite edges of the board (top-to-bottom or left-to-right).

invalid_move.invalid_move_format: Kũrora na njĩra ĩtarĩ ya kĩhooto
invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Nambari ya seli isiyo halali {cell_num}. Inabidi iwe kati ya 0 na {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Cella {cell_num} nĩ ĩkoragwo ĩrĩ na mũndũ. Thuura cella itarĩ andũ.

action.placement: Mwathani {current_player_id} akoretire mũhiganio wao ({symbol}) kwa seli {cell_num}.

outcome.draw: Bũrũri nĩ ũiyũrĩte. Nĩ ũndũ wa kũiganana!
